name: Mount Kalaga National Park
summary: Leonida's mountainous northern wilderness featuring dense pine forests, treacherous off-road trails, whitewater rivers, and off-grid settlements.
description: Rising high above the northern border of Leonida, Mount Kalaga National Park offers extreme verticality and wild wilderness. Winding mountain switchbacks, logging roads, fire lookouts, and cavern networks define the landscape. The backcountry is inhabited by wild game, survivalist off-gridders, and secluded meth lab operations hidden within remote forest clearings.

seo.title: Mount Kalaga National Park: Trails, Peaks & Hunting
seo.description: Guide to Mount Kalaga National Park in GTA VI. Northern mountains, off-road logging trails, wildlife hunting grounds, and hidden camps.
